test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find the cost of fencing of a rectangular land, if it has an area of 100 m² and one side of length 20 m at a rate of ₹30 per meter.
solution:
Given:

The cost of fencing = Rs. 30/m2

The area of rectangle = Rs. 100 m²

The length of the rectangular = 20 m

Formula used:

Area of a rectangle = l × b

Perimeter of rectangle = 2 (l + b)

l = Length of the rectangle

b = Breadth of the rectangle

Calculation:

20 × b = 100

⇒ b = 5

The perimeter of the rectangular garden = 2 (20 + 5) = 2 × 25 = 50 m

The cost of fencing = Rs. 30/metre

∴ Total cost of fencing = 50 × 30 = Rs. 1500

**The answer is 1500.**
